columns.comment: Stable product name supplied to discovery.

columns.comment: standard, a module anchor or a pattern anchor.

columns.comment: Release of the standard the component conforms to.

columns.comment: Reason an entity needs no relationship traversal.

semantic.description: Authored column meaning kept separately from physical catalogue facts.
